```scheme
(import scheme (chicken base) (chicken io))

(define (main)
  (let* ((input (read-line))
         (tokens (string-split input #\Space))
         (n (string->number (list-ref tokens 0)))
         (m (string->number (list-ref tokens 1)))
         (neighbours (make-hash-table))
         (s (string->number (list-ref tokens (+ (* 2 n) 0))))
         (t (string->number (list-ref tokens (+ (* 2 n) 1))))
         (distance (make-hash-table))
         (queue '()))
    ;; Initialize neighbors
    (do ((i 1 (+ i 1))) ((> i n))
      (hash-set! neighbours i '()))
    ;; Read edges
    (do ((i 0 (+ i 1))) ((= i m))
      (let* ((line (read-line))
             (tokens (string-split line #\Space))
             (u (string->number (list-ref tokens 0)))
             (v (string->number (list-ref tokens 1))))
        (hash-set! (hash-ref neighbours u) v #t)
        (hash-set! (hash-ref neighbours v) u #t)))
    ;; BFS initialization
    (hash-set! distance s 0)
    (set! queue (cons s queue))
    ;; BFS loop
    (let loop ()
      (if (null? queue)
          (void)
          (let* ((node (car queue))
                 (rest-queue (cdr queue)))
            (set! queue rest-queue)
            (when (= node t)
              (return))
            (for-each (lambda (other)
                        (when (and (hash-has-key? neighbours other)
                                   (not (hash-has-key? distance other)))
                          (hash-set! distance other (+ 1 (hash-ref distance node)))
                          (set! queue (cons other queue))))
                      (hash-ref neighbours node)))))
    ;; Output result
    (if (hash-has-key? distance t)
        (display (hash-ref distance t))
        (display -1))
    (newline)))

(main)
```
